# Memo: Q3 vendor consolidation decision

To: Finance and Procurement
From: Sam Okonkwo, Director of Operations
Date: October 14

We are consolidating our shipping vendors from four to two, effective November 1. This memo covers
the decision, the transition plan, and who owns each step.

## Background

We currently split shipments across four regional carriers. Rate audits this quarter showed we pay an
average of 11 percent more per shipment than comparable companies our size, largely because none of
our four contracts hit the volume-discount thresholds on their own. Combining our shipping into two carriers
gets us past those thresholds on both.

## Decision

Starting November 1, all domestic shipments route through Carrier A. International shipments route
through Carrier B. Our contracts with the other two carriers end December 31, per their standard
60-day termination clause.

## Owners and dates

Priya Shah owns the Carrier A onboarding, including warehouse system integration, due October 25.
Marcus Webb owns Carrier B's customs documentation setup, due October 28. I will handle the two
termination notices this week.

## Open questions

Finance still needs to confirm whether the new contracts affect our insurance requirements on
high-value shipments. I have a call with our broker on Thursday and will report back by Friday.
Warehouse staff should expect a short training session the week of October 21 covering the new
label formats; Priya will schedule that once onboarding is confirmed.

Reach out to me directly with questions before the November 1 cutover.
